# Heriberto Espino Montelongo — verified academic profile and research guide > Official public portfolio: https://heri-espino.github.io/. This guide is maintained by the website owner. Follow linked records for evidence; submission and revision are not journal acceptance or publication. ## Who is Heriberto Espino Montelongo? Heriberto Espino Montelongo (also publishing as Heriberto Espino-Montelongo) is an undergraduate researcher and research software developer at Universidad de las Américas Puebla (UDLAP), Mexico, studying Actuarial Science and Data Science. His work spans stochastic geometry and proximity graphs, probabilistic modeling, penalized least-squares trend estimation, interpretable machine learning, and quantitative finance. His mathematical research addresses empty-region proximity graphs and stochastic-geometric laws, while related projects study smoothness-indexed trends, financial risk and derivatives, and controlled CNN interpretability. He also develops and maintains open-source mathematical and analytical software, and has worked on statistical analysis for academic decision support. This portfolio distinguishes submitted manuscripts from working drafts, technical articles, lectures, tutorials, and citable software. - **Preferred public name:** Heriberto Espino Montelongo - **Research byline variant:** Heriberto Espino-Montelongo - **Location:** Puebla, Mexico - **Current university:** [Universidad de las Américas Puebla](https://www.udlap.mx/) - **Expanded public biography:** [About Heriberto Espino Montelongo](https://heri-espino.github.io/about-me/) - **Complete, dated public record:** [Curriculum vitae](https://heri-espino.github.io/cv/) ## Education - Bachelor of Science in Data Science — Universidad de las Américas Puebla, Aug 2023 — Dec 2026 (expected). - Bachelor of Science in Actuarial Science — Universidad de las Américas Puebla, Aug 2021 — Dec 2026 (expected). Expected completion dates are not completed or awarded degrees. ## Research interests - Stochastic geometry and random geometric graphs - Computational geometry and proximity graphs - Probability, stochastic processes, and statistical inference - Penalized least-squares smoothing and time-series trends - Interpretable machine learning and CNN interventions - Quantitative finance, derivatives, and financial risk - Scientific software and reproducible computation ## Professional and academic work - **Research Data Scientist**, Mathematics Learning Center — Universidad de las Américas Puebla (Aug 2025 — Present). - **Quantitative Analyst**, Global Equity — Actinver (Jun 2025 — Dec 2025). - **Academic Assistant**, Linear Algebra Course — Universidad de las Américas Puebla (Jan 2023 — May 2023). ## Open-source research software - **AbaQuant** — Author & Lead Developer; Aug 2024 — Present; [verified resource](https://abaquant.github.io/AbaQuant/). - **ProximityGraphs** — Co-author & Maintainer; Aug 2025 — Present; [verified resource](https://proximitygraphs.github.io/ProximityGraphs/). - **OpenAI** — Contributor; Sep 2026 — Present; [verified resource](https://github.com/openai/openai-python). - **Trend Estimation** — Author & Maintainer; May 2026 — Present; [verified resource](https://github.com/trendestimation/trendestimation). - **AwesomeFigures** — Author & Maintainer; Oct 2026 — Present; [verified resource](https://awesomefigures.github.io/awesomefigures/). - **Docling Math** — Author & Maintainer; Sep 2026 — Present; [verified resource](https://heri-espino.github.io/docling-math/). Authorship and collaboration differ by project. Consult each project's record; being a contributor is not the same as being the sole author. ## Academic presentations, leadership and affiliations - **Contributed Talk** — Asymptotic Characteristics of Proximity Graphs; 59th SMM National Congress · Sociedad Matemática Mexicana (Oct 2026). - **Poster Presenter** — ProximityGraphs Python Library; XLI Colloquium Victor Neumann-Lara · Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (Apr 2026). - **Poster Presenter** — Latent Risk Estimation in U.S. Markets; XXIV School of Probability and Statistics · Centro de Investigación en Matemáticas (Mar 2026). - **Poster Presenter** — Proximity Graphs for TDA and Machine Learning; II National Congress of Data Science · Universidad de las Américas Puebla (Oct 2025). - **President** — Preety Good Quantum OE · Universidad de las Américas Puebla (Jan 2026 — Jun 2026). - **Vice-President** — Bitwise Competitive Programming · Universidad de las Américas Puebla (Jan 2025 — Jun 2026). - **IMEF Universitario:** student member, Aug 2026–Jun 2027 (expected); not a leadership title. ## Manuscripts in editorial review or revision - [Unit-Region Factorization for Empty-Region Proximity Graphs](https://heri-espino.github.io/papers/unit-region-factorization.html) — **Under Review**; Elsevier · Discrete Applied Mathematics · Special Issue LAGOS 2025; authors: Heriberto Espino Montelongo and Héctor Maravillo. A fixed-template empty-region rule assigns a Borel region \(S(p,q)\) to a candidate pair and retains the edge when that region contains no other site. The manuscript isolates the unit-volume constant \(a_K\) for similarity-copy regions and shows how the same scalar controls exact Poisson void probabilities, incident-edge length intensities, mean out-degree, and normalized incident-edge length laws. - [Geometry and Volume of Stepping-Stone Diversion Neighborhoods in Euclidean Spaces of Arbitrary Dimension](https://heri-espino.github.io/papers/stepping-stone.html) — **Under Revision**; Elsevier · Computational Geometry; authors: Heriberto Espino Montelongo and Héctor Maravillo. This manuscript develops a geometric, graph-theoretic, and probabilistic analysis of the stepping-stone graph in \(\mathbb{R}^d\) for every \(d\geq 2\). It derives a normalized one-dimensional volume integral, recovers the degenerate and Gabriel cases and the relative-neighborhood limit, proves strict region and volume monotonicity, establishes graph inclusions and connectivity, and validates a stable quadrature formula by rejection sampling. - [When Do Activation-Patching Effects Add Up? Evidence from Controlled CNNs](https://heri-espino.github.io/papers/activation-patching-effects-add-up.html) — **Under Review**; Springer Nature · SN Computer Science; authors: Heriberto Espino-Montelongo. This study asks when the effects of joint activation-channel patches can be predicted by summing individual channel changes. In controlled convolutional networks, intervention-size effects can occur even under exact logit additivity; other architectures exhibit substantial departures that can reverse a training-regime contrast. - [Template Priors in Small CNNs: Learning Dynamics and the Measurement Dependence of Causal Usefulness](https://heri-espino.github.io/projects/cnn-primitive-bases.html) — **Under Review**; Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR) · Double-blind review; authors: Heriberto Espino Montelongo. A controlled study of template initialization, retention, and release in small CNNs on two rendering tasks. Across staged experiments with \(n=400\) primary runs, \(n=200\) gradual-release runs, \(80\) final checkpoints, and \(2{,}000\) saved states, template initialization does not uniformly accelerate learning; releasing retention improves compositional accuracy relative to constant retention while reducing alignment; and the relative causal-usefulness difference changes with channel ranking and intervention size. ## Published articles and technical writing (not peer-reviewed journal publications) - [AbaQuant. Finanzas matemáticas, valuación y gestión del riesgo](https://heri-espino.github.io/articles/abaquant-finanzas-matematicas.html) — La Catarina · UDLAP · IMEF Universitario; Heriberto Espino Montelongo and Owen Paredes Conde. Technical article by Heriberto Espino Montelongo (first-listed author) and Owen Paredes Conde introducing AbaQuant, an open-source Python library for financial mathematics: valuation, investments, portfolio construction, derivatives, market risk, and structured credit. Describes the library's use of financial market data, numerical methods, and interactive applications. ## Other working manuscripts, lectures and tutorials - [Smoothness-Integrated Trend Distances with Nonzero Difference Drift](https://heri-espino.github.io/papers/smoothness-integrated-trend-distances.html) — **Working Draft**; Working draft. - [Dynamic Forecast-Optimal Smoothness for Penalized Trend Estimation](https://heri-espino.github.io/papers/dynamic-forecast-optimal-smoothness.html) — **Working Draft**; Research manuscript draft. - [Smoothness-Indexed Penalized Trend Estimation in Python: Parameter-Search Coordinates, Numerical Backends, and Reproducible Comparisons](https://heri-espino.github.io/papers/smoothness-indexed-pls-python.html) — **Working Draft**; Research manuscript draft. - [Posterior Integration and Volatility Inputs in WTI Asian Options](https://heri-espino.github.io/papers/posterior-integration-volatility-wti-asian-options.html) — **Working Draft**; Blinded manuscript draft. - [Componentwise kNN-Isomap: From Neighborhood Graphs to Constrained Manifold Embeddings](https://heri-espino.github.io/papers/componentwise-knn-isomap-lecture.html) — **Research Lecture**; Mathematical lecture. - [From Max-Cut to Semidefinite Programming, EVA, and Clustering-Based Rounding](https://heri-espino.github.io/papers/maxcut-sdp-eva-clustering-tutorial.html) — **Research Tutorial**; Mathematical tutorial. - [Beyond the Incentive Threshold: Academic Support Use and Persistence After a First-Year Participation Incentive](https://heri-espino.github.io/papers/academic-support-persistence-incentive.html) — **Working Paper**; Working paper. - [Mathematics Support Use and Classroom-Relative Performance in First-Year University Mathematics](https://heri-espino.github.io/papers/mathematics-support-classroom-performance.html) — **Research Draft**; Research draft. - [Are Course Grades Comparable Across Classrooms?
